name: link
title: Link
description: Inline text link. Always rendered as an <a>, never a Button — links navigate, buttons act. Three appearances — default (text.primary with underline-on-hover, the prose default), subtle (text.secondary, navigation flavor), and accent (text.accent, sparingly — emphasis on a single CTA inside prose). External links signal with a trailing arrow / ExternalLink glyph and rel='noreferrer noopener'.
